name: caches successful predictions by image and model key
input: two models, one shared image, and repeated requests
test:
calls = []
class Model:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
    def predict(self, value):
        calls.append(('predict', self.name, value))
        return f'{self.name}:{value}'
def download(image_id):
    calls.append(('download', image_id))
    return f'raw-{image_id}'
def sanitize(raw):
    calls.append(('sanitize', raw))
    return raw.upper()
service = ImagePredictionService(download, sanitize, {'a': Model('a'), 'b': Model('b')}, capacity=2)
assert service.predict('img', 'a') == 'a:RAW-IMG'
assert service.predict('img', 'a') == 'a:RAW-IMG'
assert service.predict('img', 'b') == 'b:RAW-IMG'
assert calls.count(('download', 'img')) == 2
assert calls.count(('sanitize', 'raw-img')) == 2
assert calls.count(('predict', 'a', 'RAW-IMG')) == 1
assert calls.count(('predict', 'b', 'RAW-IMG')) == 1
